# NoteCord: Plaud alternative without an extra device
URL: https://notecord.nl/plaud-alternative-iphone/

One less device to carry .
NoteCord is a Plaud alternative without an extra device, using the iPhone or iPad you already have. If you want to record a conversation without carrying another recorder, NoteCord uses your device’s microphone.
Download NoteCord
The short answer
You want to remember the conversation without buying another device to carry. NoteCord is an iPhone and iPad app that records, transcribes and summarizes conversations on the device itself. Summaries with action points require Apple Intelligence. No account is needed. NoteCord never sends your recordings to us. They only reach someone else if you share them. There is no NoteCord server.
How Plaud works
According to Plaud’s own site, Plaud sells separate recording devices: NotePin, Note and Note Pro. You buy and carry them alongside your phone. The free Starter plan includes 300 transcription minutes per month. More minutes need a paid monthly or yearly plan. Plaud’s privacy policy says uploaded files are transmitted to and stored in its cloud storage service. Cloud sync is required for its web and desktop apps. Plaud operates servers in the United States, Germany, Japan and Singapore and works with third-party LLM service providers. Its policy says it does not use your data to train its own or third-party AI models without your explicit consent in advance.
How NoteCord is different
NoteCord uses your iPhone or iPad, so you do not need an extra device. Its App Store privacy label is “Data Not Collected”. Recording continues with the screen locked and is visible in Dynamic Island and on the Lock Screen. You can search through all your conversations and keep folders for each project or client. On iPad, tap your handwriting to hear what was said at that moment. NoteCord records with the iPhone or iPad microphone. It does not join Zoom, Meet or Teams calls.
When Plaud is the better choice
If you want a dedicated wearable recorder that records without taking out your phone, Plaud is the better fit. It also offers web and desktop apps and team plans.
What goes into backups
NoteCord audio is excluded from every backup. Text goes into your iPhone’s regular iCloud backup only if that backup is on, in your own iCloud.
Questions people ask
Is there a Plaud alternative iPhone app without an extra device?
Yes. NoteCord uses the iPhone or iPad you already have to record and transcribe conversations on the device itself.
How many free transcription minutes does Plaud include?
Plaud’s free Starter plan includes 300 transcription minutes per month. More minutes need a paid monthly or yearly plan.
Does NoteCord need an account or send recordings to a server?
No account is needed. NoteCord never sends your recordings to us. They only reach someone else if you share them. There is no NoteCord server.
Can NoteCord summarize conversations with action points?
Yes, on the device itself. Summaries with action points require Apple Intelligence.
Does Plaud use my data to train AI models?
Plaud’s privacy policy says it does not use your data to train its own or third-party AI models without your explicit consent in advance.
Your conversations stay on your iPhone .

# NoteCord: Pocket AI recorder alternative for iPhone
URL: https://notecord.nl/pocket-ai-recorder-alternative/

Record with the phone you have .
NoteCord is a Pocket AI recorder alternative for iPhone and iPad if you want to record conversations without buying another device. If you’re concerned about where your recordings go, NoteCord records and transcribes on the device itself. Summaries with action points also run on the device and require Apple Intelligence.
Download NoteCord
The short answer
Another device to carry may be more than you want just to remember a conversation. NoteCord is an iPhone and iPad app that records, transcribes and summarizes conversations on the device itself. Summaries with action points require Apple Intelligence. You don’t need an account. NoteCord never sends your recordings to us. They only reach someone else if you share them. There is no NoteCord server.
How Pocket works
According to Pocket’s own site, Pocket is a separate clip-on AI voice recorder listed at $139, with 64 GB of storage. It records on its own. Its privacy policy says audio is captured only when you start recording. You can record offline, and recordings sync when you reconnect. Transcription and model processing run with cloud and AI vendors. Pocket says it will not use your personal recordings to train its models without your consent. You can sign in from any device to see your recordings.
How NoteCord is different
NoteCord uses the iPhone or iPad you already have. It records and transcribes on the device itself. Summaries with action points require Apple Intelligence and also run on the device. Its App Store privacy label is “Data Not Collected”. Recording continues with the screen locked and is visible in Dynamic Island and on the Lock Screen. You can search through all your conversations and use folders per project or client. On iPad, tap your handwriting to hear what was said at that moment. NoteCord records with your iPhone or iPad microphone. It does not join Zoom, Meet or Teams calls.
When Pocket is the better choice
Pocket is the better choice if you want a recorder that records without your phone. It has its own microphones and battery. It also offers sync across devices, with recordings you can see by signing in from any device.
What goes into backups
NoteCord audio is excluded from every backup. Text goes into your iPhone’s regular iCloud backup only if that backup is on, in your own iCloud.
Questions people ask
Is there a Pocket AI recorder alternative for iPhone?
Yes. NoteCord records and transcribes on your iPhone or iPad itself. You don’t need an extra device or an account.
Does Pocket process recordings in the cloud?
Pocket’s privacy policy says transcription and model processing run with cloud and AI vendors. It says personal recordings will not be used to train its models without your consent.
Does NoteCord send my recordings to a server?
NoteCord never sends your recordings to us. They only reach someone else if you share them. There is no NoteCord server.
Can NoteCord summarize conversations on my iPhone?
Yes. NoteCord summarizes on the device itself. Summaries with action points require Apple Intelligence.
Are NoteCord recordings included in iCloud backups?
Audio is excluded from every backup. Text is included in your iPhone’s regular iCloud backup only if that backup is on, in your own iCloud.
Your conversations stay on your iPhone .

# NoteCord privacy: conversations stay on your device
URL: https://notecord.nl/privacy/

Your conversations stay yours
We keep your audio, transcripts and summaries on your device.
The app
NoteCord has no server of its own. You don’t need an account. We cannot see your conversations.
Your own backup
Audio stays on your device and is excluded from every backup. Text is included in your own iCloud if your iPhone’s regular iCloud backup is on.
Purchases and downloads
Apple handles purchases. We see neither payment details nor who bought the app. When you download a speech model, the server delivering it sees your IP address, as with any download.
The website
We use no cookies, trackers or third-party scripts. Your browser stores a copy of the page on your device so the site works offline. Our web host sees IP addresses in its logs.
Your rights and who we are
Email us to access, correct or delete your personal data. You can also lodge a complaint with the Dutch Data Protection Authority, the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens.
Danny Schuurman Nederland danny@apexpartnerships.nl
Back to home

# NoteCord: private AI note taker for iPhone
URL: https://notecord.nl/private-ai-note-taker-iphone/

Private AI note taker for iPhone
NoteCord is an app for iPhone and iPad that records, transcribes and summarizes conversations while keeping recordings and text on your device. There is no server or cloud of ours, and you don’t need an account.
Download NoteCord
You look down. They keep talking.
A client is telling you something that matters. You start typing so you won’t forget it. When you look up, they’ve moved on. You have the words you managed to catch, but you missed the look on their face.
Some conversations feel too personal to send.
Someone else’s cloud feels wrong for a sensitive conversation. NoteCord records, transcribes and summarizes on your device. There is no NoteCord server. You don’t need an account. We see nothing. Apple’s App Store privacy label is “Data Not Collected”.
What goes into a backup?
Audio is never included in any backup. Text goes into your own iCloud only through your iPhone’s standard iCloud backup, if that backup is enabled. Whether to use that backup stays your choice.
Screen locked. Still recording.
Your phone lies dark on the table. You look at the person speaking. Recording continues with the screen locked, visible in Dynamic Island and on the lock screen. Mark a moment from the lock screen.
Keep track of what you agreed.
Keep what you agreed: a summary with action points requires Apple Intelligence. Search all your conversations. Keep a folder per client or project. Type a note beside a moment. On iPad, tap your handwriting to hear what was said.
Questions people ask
Does NoteCord upload my recordings to the cloud?
No. NoteCord never sends your recordings to us. They only reach someone else if you share them. There is no NoteCord server.
Does NoteCord collect my data?
No. “Data Not Collected” is Apple’s App Store privacy label. We have no server of our own and cannot see your recordings or text.
Do I need an account?
No. You can use NoteCord without an account.
Does my text go into iCloud?
Yes, but only through your iPhone’s standard iCloud backup, if it is enabled. Your text is then included in that backup in your own iCloud. Audio is never included in any backup.
Does NoteCord transcribe on my iPhone or on a server?
NoteCord transcribes on your iPhone. There is no NoteCord server.
Can I record a lecture or meeting with my screen locked?
Yes. Recording continues with your screen locked. You can see it in Dynamic Island and on the lock screen, and mark a moment from the lock screen.
Stop taking notes. Start listening .

# NoteCord: record a lecture without an account
URL: https://notecord.nl/record-lecture-without-account/

Record a lecture without an account
NoteCord is an app for iPhone and iPad that records, transcribes and summarizes conversations while keeping recordings and text on your device. You can record a lecture and get a summary without an account; summaries with action points require Apple Intelligence.
Download NoteCord
Stop taking notes. Start listening.
NoteCord records and transcribes your lecture on your device without an account. Summaries with action points require Apple Intelligence. Mark a moment during the recording and add a note or photo.
Screen locked. Still recording.
The recording continues when you lock your iPhone screen. You can see it in Dynamic Island and on the lock screen. You can also mark a moment from either place.
Remember a word. Find the conversation.
Search across all your conversations to find a lecture again. Keep each subject in its own project folder. On iPad, tap handwriting written during a recording to hear what was said at that moment.
Your conversations stay on your iPhone.
NoteCord never sends your recordings to us. They only reach someone else if you share them. There is no NoteCord server. Audio stays on your device and is excluded from every backup. Text stays on your device and is included only in your iPhone’s regular iCloud backup if enabled, in your own iCloud.
Questions people ask
Can I record a lecture and get a summary without creating an account?
Yes. NoteCord records, transcribes and summarizes on your device without an account. Summaries with action points require Apple Intelligence.
Will NoteCord keep recording if I lock my phone?
Yes. Recording continues with the screen locked and is visible in Dynamic Island and on the lock screen.
Can I add a note or photo at a specific moment in a lecture?
Yes. Mark a moment during the recording and add a note or photo. You can find the note later through search.
Can I tap my iPad handwriting to hear that part of the lecture?
Yes. Tap handwriting written during the recording to hear what was said at that moment. This applies only to handwriting written during a recording.
Does NoteCord send my lecture recordings to a server?
No. NoteCord never sends your recordings to us. They only reach someone else if you share them. There is no NoteCord server.
Listen to the lecture .

# NoteCord support: help with the iPhone and iPad app
URL: https://notecord.nl/support/

Help with NoteCord
Find answers to common questions about NoteCord on iPhone and iPad. If your question isn’t covered, get in touch.
Download NoteCord
Questions people ask
How do I start and stop a recording?
Tap the record button to begin, or ask Siri to start or stop a recording. Recording continues when you lock the screen. You can see the recording on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island on a supported iPhone.
How do I find an important moment again?
Tap the flag during a recording to mark a moment. Later, you can listen from just before that moment. On iPad, you can also write with Apple Pencil and tap your handwriting later to hear that moment.
Where is my recording transcribed?
Transcription happens on your device. iOS may ask for permission to download an Apple speech model once.
Why am I not getting a summary?
Summaries with action items need Apple Intelligence. You need a supported device, Apple Intelligence turned on and its model ready to use. If summaries aren’t working, check these in Settings.
Do I need an account?
No account is needed. NoteCord has no server of its own.
Are my recordings included in a backup?
Audio stays on your device and is never included in any backup. Text is included in your iPhone’s regular backup if it’s turned on. If you delete the app or erase your device without exporting first, the audio is lost.
How can I share a recording or transcript?
You can share or email audio and transcripts yourself, including with “Send to myself”. Your own notes and handwriting aren’t included in an export.
How do I find a conversation?
You can search all your conversations for words, names and notes. Use folders to organise conversations by client, project or topic.
How do I cancel my Pro subscription?
Pro is a monthly or yearly subscription through Apple. On your iPhone or iPad, go to Settings > your name > Subscriptions > NoteCord and cancel at least 24 hours before your billing period ends to prevent renewal. You keep Pro until the end of that period; after that, the free version keeps working and everything you created stays on your device.
How do I request a refund?
Purchases are handled by Apple. You can request a refund from Apple at reportaproblem.apple.com.
Is your question not here?
Need help? Email danny@apexpartnerships.nl and briefly describe what you’re having trouble with.
Stop taking notes. Start listening .
Try NoteCord for recordings, transcripts and summaries on your iPhone or iPad.

# NoteCord: terms of use for the iPhone and iPad app
URL: https://notecord.nl/terms/

Terms of Use
These terms apply to your use of NoteCord on iPhone and iPad.
Apple’s terms
NoteCord is covered by Apple’s standard terms for apps: the Licensed Application End User License Agreement. Read them at www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/ .
NoteCord Pro
NoteCord Pro is available as a monthly or yearly subscription through Apple, with a free trial. After the trial, the subscription becomes paid. Payment is charged to your Apple Account. The subscription renews automatically unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the trial or current subscription period. To manage or cancel it, open Settings on your iPhone, tap your name, then tap Subscriptions. A one-time founders’ purchase is also available until 1 December 2026, inclusive. This gives you lifetime Pro without a subscription.
Refunds
Apple handles refunds. You can request a refund at reportaproblem.apple.com .
Recordings and consent
NoteCord keeps your recordings and text on your device. You are responsible for obtaining consent from the people you record, in accordance with the rules that apply where you are.
Privacy
Read the privacy page .
Contact
Questions about these terms? Contact us at danny@apexpartnerships.nl .
